# `mise tasks info`

- **Usage:** `mise tasks info [-J --json] <TASK>`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/tasks/info.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/tasks/info.rs)

Show a task's definition

Prints the task's description, source file, dependencies, sources, outputs, run commands, environment, and usage spec. `--json` prints the full definition.

## Arguments
- **`<TASK>`** — Name of the task to get information about

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Show the test task and the file that defines it

```
mise tasks info test
```

Get the full structured task definition

```
mise tasks info test --json
```
